meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.
meta.coverage: The general government's receipts, spending, taxes and deficit as per cent of GDP, budget, revised and accounts, 2004-05 to 2010-11, over GDP on the 2004-05 base
meta.note: RBI Bulletin, Combined Receipts and Disbursements of the Central and State Governments (DBIE report 36), the per-cent-of-GDP rows, over GDP on the 2004-05 base (the table's note 1: the 2011-12 base from 2011-12). Each stage its own series.
